release_effect: public release remains blocked pending specialist equivalence review
determination: The component frameworks and several structural mechanisms are established. No exact indexed match was located for the complete paired HINC binary-Gerstenhaber classification under the searched presentations and equations. Historical priority remains unestablished.

sources.citation: Thorsten Holm, Hochschild cohomology rings of algebras k[X]/(f)
sources.role: explicit Hochschild cohomology rings for one-relation algebras
sources.effect_on_hinc: The ambient dual-number cup algebra is established territory. HINC now derives its exact characteristic-two specialization directly.

sources.citation: Tian Yang, A Batalin-Vilkovisky Algebra structure on the Hochschild Cohomology of Truncated Polynomials
sources.role: truncated-polynomial BV and induced Gerstenhaber structures
sources.effect_on_hinc: The ambient BV/Gerstenhaber framework is not new. Characteristic and convention matching must be checked before importing a displayed formula.

sources.citation: Selene Sanchez-Flores, The Lie structure on the Hochschild cohomology of a modular group algebra
sources.role: positive-characteristic Gerstenhaber brackets and Witt-type structure
sources.effect_on_hinc: Nontrivial modular Gerstenhaber brackets are established; the exact HINC subalgebras and endomorphism functors are not supplied.

sources.citation: Reiner Hermann, Monoidal Categories and the Gerstenhaber Bracket in Hochschild Cohomology
sources.role: functorial Gerstenhaber bracket and squaring machinery
sources.effect_on_hinc: Bracket functoriality and squaring are established. HINC must state whether it preserves only the binary bracket or stronger positive-characteristic structure.

sources.citation: Benjamin Briggs and Lleonard Rubio y Degrassi, Stable invariance of the restricted Lie algebra structure of Hochschild cohomology
sources.role: restricted p-power operation and B-infinity origin in positive characteristic
sources.effect_on_hinc: A positive-characteristic endomorphism claim must distinguish cup-and-binary-bracket preservation from restricted, brace, or B-infinity preservation.

sources.citation: Michel Brion, On Algebraic Semigroups and Monoids
sources.role: general algebraic semigroup and monoid structure; matrix monoids; units; curves; nonreduced semigroup-scheme examples
sources.effect_on_hinc: Upper-triangular multiplication, unit groups, idempotents, reducible monoids, and nonreduced semigroup schemes are established mechanisms. Brion works mainly with reduced varieties and does not classify the HINC pair.

sources.citation: Michel Brion, On Algebraic Semigroups and Monoids, II
sources.role: idempotent-scheme structure of algebraic semigroups and monoids
sources.effect_on_hinc: Reduced commutative idempotent behavior is established. The HINC even nonreduced idempotent component is not covered by a claim about reduced algebraic varieties without translation.

sources.citation: Alvaro Rittatore, Algebraic monoids and group embeddings
sources.role: unit groups and group embeddings in algebraic monoids
sources.effect_on_hinc: The open-unit-group framework is established and cannot carry novelty.

sources.citation: Alexander Perepechko, Affine algebraic monoids as endomorphisms' monoids of finite-dimensional algebras
sources.role: realization of affine algebraic monoids as endomorphism monoids
sources.effect_on_hinc: Producing unusual endomorphism-monoid geometry is not new by itself. The theorem's variety convention does not automatically establish the nonreduced HINC even scheme, and it does not give the exact Gerstenhaber-derived pair.

sources.identifier: Journal of Pure and Applied Algebra 193 (2004), 123-127; DOI:10.1016/j.jpaa.2004.03.004
sources.role: nonreduced automorphism schemes in positive characteristic
sources.effect_on_hinc: Infinitesimal and nonreduced symmetry schemes are established phenomena.

sources.citation: Alberto Elduque, Automorphism group schemes and Weyl groups of gradings
sources.role: scheme-theoretic automorphism groups over arbitrary fields
sources.effect_on_hinc: Arbitrary-base automorphism-group-scheme methodology is established. HINC remains an endomorphism-monoid instance with separate equations.

sources.citation: Sergey Dzhunusov and Yulia Zaitseva, Commutative algebraic monoid structures on affine surfaces
sources.role: classification of commutative monoid structures on normal affine surfaces in characteristic zero
sources.effect_on_hinc: This is close classification literature but does not subsume the nonnormal reducible crossing, the nonreduced even scheme, or characteristic-two arbitrary-base functor.

sources.citation: Boris Bilich, Classification of noncommutative monoid structures on normal affine surfaces
sources.role: classification of noncommutative monoids on normal affine surfaces
sources.effect_on_hinc: The HINC even object is nonreduced and not a normal affine surface. The classification does not yield the exact endomorphism scheme.
The center, subgroup, base-change, and quotient language must be stated functorially and cannot be inferred only from field points.
